decisions.reason: Launched only in 2024 as part of the firm's precast-concrete automation line, the combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine carries substantial sunk development costs and visible commitment, and after the 2024 withdrawal of four robots management will want to justify its remaining hardware offering and attribute weak early sales to the depressed construction market.

The production analysis software is cheap to maintain, supports the firm's announced digitalization direction, and complements its installed machinery base, so there is little pressure to drop it so soon after launch.
